_sobre: Format example of the typing terminal, with no brand: 16:9, a light terminal with two commands (a list of four lines, then a count), the caption below, the camera slowly coming closer from the corner where the command is typed, the closing with the logo alone. The recording (example-light/terminal.json) is the real output of the placeholder commands in example-light/commands.json. Greys, placeholder commands and captions and the placeholder logo stand for the person's brand and content: swap them. Render: node scripts/example-fonts.mjs <output>/.work-typing-terminal-example-light && node templates/typing-terminal/render.mjs templates/typing-terminal/example-light.json --out <output> --mode final
